concept.zh: 双电池撤离 · 追踪与巡逻

brief.zh: 带走两块电池，再从出口撤离。追踪号会追向你，守门号沿固定路线巡逻。同格相撞或迎面交换位置都会被抓。用完回合仍未撤离也算失败。从容模式下，同一程序要在三张地图都撤离。
brief.en: Collect both batteries and reach the exit. Tracker pursues you while Gatekeeper follows a fixed patrol. Landing on the same tile or trading places head-on gets you caught. Running out of turns also loses. In Relaxed mode, one program must escape all three maps.
